Roads & Transportation
The Town of Lincoln’s Public Works department is responsible for the operation and maintenance of Lincoln’s road network. Currently, Public Works oversees approximately 300km of roadway including 49 bridges and 130 culverts. Lincoln’s Public Works Department strives to provide residents with the highest quality of service for public infrastructure.
Key activities include:
Road signage inventory, inspections, maintenance and repairs
Road surface repairs (ie. potholes, hot asphalt, tar & chip spraying, etc.)
Rural tree maintenance (ie. brushing, trimming, removals, etc.)
Litter pick-up and animal carcass removal
Sidewalk inspections and maintenance
Guardrail maintenance
Street cleaning/sweeping
Ditching and culvert installations and repairs
Winter maintenance
Catch basin and ditch inlet maintenance
Gravel shoulder maintenance
Road patrolling
Rural roadside mowing
